title: INFO511 NHANES wrangling-v1: draft instructor rubric

criteria.description: Review every selected public source value and missing position after DEMO-anchored join and reshape; retain SEQN/reading keys, age and matched/no_BPXO_record. CSV correctness evidence covers values only.
Inspect learner-authored one-to-one join validation, key/missingness audits, pivot roundtrip and source-frame preservation in the submitted notebook. No checkbox or monitoring inference.
Review the at-most-150-word explanation of participant versus participant/reading units, unmatched versus present-but-missing and reproducible saved code. No population, causal or medical claim.
Review explicit assistance declaration; valid no_ai is equally acceptable. Private hint/coaching/monitoring content is excluded.
